categories_thin: Tutoring and test prep: no independent tutoring or test-prep center with a Bound Brook or South Bound Brook address could be confirmed; only region-wide providers (Somerset Learning Center, Mathnasium of Bridgewater) surfaced.
Hotels and motels: no independent hotel or motel in either borough was found; the nearest flagged properties were branded hotels in Bridgewater.

Title agencies, architects, environmental consultants and financial advisers: only out-of-town title agencies (Piscataway) and Route 22 advisers in Bridgewater turned up; no in-borough architect, title agency or environmental firm could be confirmed.

Childcare and preschool: the state licensed list shows mostly school-based and district-linked programs (Middle Earth, Work Family Connection) plus one independent center (Big Hugs); district pre-K and a national chain were excluded, so true independent capacity looks thin.
Funeral homes: only one independent funeral home (Hagan-Chamberlain) serves both boroughs.

General retail on Main Street: the BID's 52-business district list is dominated by restaurants, salons and groceries, and only a handful of true independent non-food shops exist (boutiques, florists, jewelry, variety, bike/motorcycle).
caveats: Zone boundary: Bound Brook postal addresses (08805) extend into Bridgewater Township along Route 22 and Chimney Rock Road. Businesses on US-22 and upper Chimney Rock Road were treated as outside the two boroughs and excluded; several also sit just past 10 miles line-of-sight from Milltown.

Distance: the far west side of Bound Brook (West Union Ave near Route 22, and the Easy Street industrial pocket) is roughly 10.0-10.5 miles straight-line from central Milltown (40.4498, -74.4407). Entries there (e.g. Viking Pest at 9 Easy St, U S Dollar Plus at 611 W Union Ave) are legally in Bound Brook but at the edge of the radius.

Several salons, barbers, laundromats and dental/health offices appear under two different names at the same street address (Parlor 420 / Glam Kulture, Bonita's / Meli's, Laundromat Center / Bill's, Xtreem Kleen / Klean Bubbles, Kynetex / Performance Health Clinics, Somerset Family Dentistry / Dr. Nicole Padovan). They are kept as single merged entries with both names noted; the buyer should confirm the current trade name.
South Bound Brook coverage rests heavily on one source (NJTGO, researched September 2026). Its listings are unusually complete for such a small borough but were not independently verified one by one.

School-based programs (Middle Earth at Smalley and Lafayette, Work Family Connection at LaMonte and South Bound Brook) operate inside public school buildings and are nonprofit providers; they are included as childcare/education operators but may not be businesses the owner wants to target.

Excluded by rule: ShopRite, Family Dollar, CTown, QuickChek, Great Clips, Boost Mobile, Cricket, Metro by T-Mobile, Visionworks, H&R Block, The Learning Experience, Home Depot, State Farm and Allstate branded agency offices, J.P. Morgan/Chase, and the Ukrainian National Federal Credit Union. Branded fuel (Sunoco on Main St in South Bound Brook, Foothill's Gulf pumps) was excluded as a fuel franchise, but Foothill's repair/body business is included.

Bulk-directory entries: many entries come from a single directory (marked 'one directory only'). The BID directory, NJTGO and boundbrook.com all allow business self-submission, so a listing is not proof of current operation.

Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, Justia, Martindale and WhereOrg block automated fetching here (HTTP 403 / Cloudflare); their data in this file comes only from search-result snippets, which sometimes omit street addresses.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass API returned nothing (request timed out), so no map-based cross-check of the two boroughs was possible.
Google Maps served only a limited five-result anonymous view and Bing Maps needed JavaScript with no readable listings, so map-based category sweeps are incomplete.
Neither borough publishes an online business registry, licensed-business list or economic-development directory; boundbrook-nj.org only lists borough departments and the public defender.
Somerset County chamber and economic-development member directories were not reachable in usable form; the only chamber hit was the state chamber's city page listing two Bound Brook businesses.

Several businesses could not be given a street address from accessible sources: Gentle Dentist Diayka, AMA Contracting, Bateman Printing Service, All Children's Art Center's Bound Brook studio, and the tree/landscaping firms that publish only service-area information.
A licensed appraiser (Robert C. Heuner) appears in the federal appraisal registry with a Bound Brook address that looks residential; omitted under the no-home-address rule.

An RWJBarnabas-affiliated internal-medicine practice at 141 Main St, South Bound Brook is recorded only through its physician listing, because the parent is a large health system and the practice's own name was not confirmed.
